meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在代码工作中会优先委派给三个子代理:定位代码、1-2 个文件的修改、检查代码差异。这些子代理返回的结果很短,Claude 的上下文占用更低,能处理更长任务。
howto.when: 当用户要求定位代码、改动一两个文件或检查代码改动时,Claude 会派出对应子代理执行任务。

say.text: 帮我找一下 login 函数在哪些文件里被调用了
say.note: Claude 会派定位专用子代理,返回简洁的行号列表。

say.text: 把 config.js 第 51 行改成读取环境变量
say.note: Claude 会派小修改子代理,改后回读验证结果。

say.text: 审查一下我刚才做的代码改动有没有 bug
say.note: Claude 会派审查子代理,返回带严重度的代码问题列表。

howto.what_en: With this installed, Claude delegates code tasks to three subagents: locate code, edit 1-2 files, review diffs. Their compressed output lowers main-context cost per delegation, so sessions last longer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task is to locate code, edit one or two files, or review a code change.

say_en.text: Find the definition of login and all files that call it.
say_en.note: Claude dispatches the locate subagent and returns a compact file-line list.

say_en.text: Change config.js line 51 to read an environment variable.
say_en.note: Claude runs the small-edit subagent and then verifies the result.

say_en.text: Review the code change I just made for potential bugs.
say_en.note: Claude invokes the review subagent and lists findings by severity.
